text:
Ravi: Kicking off fractional rollout for v3.1.1 — goal 0->8->20 over 22m. Change window 18:00-19:00 UTC. Starting with NA-east slice. /deploy release=v3.1.1 percent=4->8 slice=na-east

deploy-bot: [18:00:02] Deploy started: v3.1.1 -> canary 4% (NA-east). CI: green. Dashboard: https://deploy.internal/r/3901234567

Hannah: Watching latency and errors. Hold if p95>200ms or error_rate>0.5% for 3m.

Luis: Early signal: p95 NA-east = 215ms, errors 0.35% at 18:03. trending slightly up. panel: https://grafana.internal/d/na/canary-overview

Ravi: Safety: do not auto-advance if nvocation queue > 80% or KV evictions spike. @sre-oncall can you run quick-check?

sre-oncall: Running `./ops/quick_health --region=na-east --past=5m`. Result: invocation queue 72%, KV evictions normal, no OOMs. Slight tail latency but infra looks ok.

deploy-bot: [18:06:10] Scheduled ramp: 4% -> 8% in 6m. Safety checks: kv_cache_pressure=false, oom_risk=low, queue=72%

Hannah: p95 now 238ms and errors 0.6% at 18:08. This exceeds thresholds. Recommend pause and vote for region pin to v3.1.0.

qa-eng: QA: running focused regression on top 50 prompts in na-east-like env. ETA 30m. Will post results.

Ravi: OK pausing ramp. @deploy-bot apply-pin region=na-east version=v3.1.0 reason="p95>200ms + errors breached"

deploy-bot: [18:09:05] Action: ramp paused. NA-east pinned to v3.1.0. Global canary remains 6% excluding NA-east. Manual pin applied; no automatic rollback executed.

Luis: Filing INC-8012: "NA-east canary tail latency bump during fractional rollout" and attaching traces + grafana.

sre-oncall: I'll run deeper correlation: checking node CPU, network, and kernel updates for NA-east. Initial glance shows one infra config push at 17:58 (sidecar logging level change) — investigating if it affected CPU.

Ravi: If QA green + infra fix within 45m we can unpin and resume with cautious 2% step. If not fixed by 18:50 schedule staged rollback for NA-east at 18:55.

Hannah: Agree. I'll update release notes: "NA-east slice paused at ~6% due to latency; region pinned to v3.1.0 pending investigation."

deploy-bot: [18:12:30] Note: release notes auto-draft created at https://docs.internal/releases/v3.1.1-draft. Rollback timer scheduled for 18:55 for region=na-east unless cleared."
